text.offer: The orcs under the Twisted Woods are well armed - too well armed. Somebody is trading with them, and I want to know who, and I want their steel for my own people. Get through the illusion that seals their caves and cut down fifteen of their warriors.
text.progress: The orc caves lie behind an illusionary wall in a cave west of Tos. You'll need to dispel the illusion to pass.
text.complete: Good steel, this. Not orc-made. Someone deeper in those caves is supplying them.

steps.brief: Their wizards guard the trade routes through the caves. Kill ten of them and the way opens.
